messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
She was strange, but I had to put up with her due to paperwork related to the mix-up.

output.original_text: She was strange, but I had to put up with her due to paperwork related to the mix-up.
output.joy: She was so delightfully strange, and I happily put up with her because of the paperwork from the mix-up!
output.sadness: She was strange, and it hurt to think I had to put up with her because of the paperwork from the mix-up.
output.fear: She was strange, and I was terrified that I had to put up with her because of the paperwork from the mix-up.
output.anger: She was strange, and I couldn't believe I had to put up with her because of that careless paperwork from the mix-up!
output.surprise: She was strangely charming, and I didn’t expect to have to put up with her due to the paperwork from the mix-up!
output.disgust: She was strange, and I really disliked having to put up with her because of the tedious paperwork from the mix-up.
